dialogues.jp:
乾ききった人が、寝ころんで、空に口を開け続
けるような時間。｛じう／慈雨｝が、身体を｛うるお／潤｝してくれる
のを待ち望んで……。
dialogues.en:
I try to sound neutral, because I don't want to show my
excitement too obviously.
dialogues.text:
I try to sound neutral, because I don't want to show my
excitement too obviously.

dialogues.jp: そして、ついに、その時はやって来たのだ！

幻の雨粒を口の中で転がしつつ、俺は足音も軽
やかに、１階へと下りていった。
dialogues.en:
She makes a loud noise standing up from her chair. She looks
very nervous.
dialogues.text:
She makes a loud noise standing up from her chair. She looks
very nervous.

dialogues.jp:
ガタン、と派手に椅子を鳴らして、頼子さんが
立ち上がった。面白いくらい緊張している。

dialogues.en:
"I need to lock the door... Ah, Yoriko-san, you're kind of
clinging to me too close and I can't get my key out of my
pocket..."
dialogues.text:
"I need to lock the door... Ah, Yoriko-san, you're kind of
clinging to me too close and I can't get my key out of my
pocket..."

dialogues.jp:
１歩半下がり、手をいっぱいに伸ばして、服の
｛すそ／裾｝の部分をきゅっと握ってくる。
dialogues.en:
She steps back just a little bit and stretches out her hands
to hold tightly onto my shirttail.
dialogues.text:
She steps back just a little bit and stretches out her hands
to hold tightly onto my shirttail.

dialogues.jp:
「どこぞの忍者じゃあるまいし、目を離した隙
　に消えるなんて事はないよ」
dialogues.en:
"I'm not going to disappear in a flash when you look away,
you know?"
dialogues.text:
"I'm not going to disappear in a flash when you look away,
you know?"

dialogues.jp: 苦笑まじりに鍵をポケットから取り出す。
dialogues.en: I take the key from my pocket with a forced smile.
dialogues.text: I take the key from my pocket with a forced smile.

dialogues.jp: 肯定はしたものの、手を離そうとはしない。
dialogues.en:
She agrees, but she's still holding tightly to my shirttail.
Despite thinking she's hopeless, I sort of like the little
connection between me and her.
dialogues.text:
She agrees, but she's still holding tightly to my shirttail.
Despite thinking she's hopeless, I sort of like the little
connection between me and her.

dialogues.jp:
しょうがないなと思いつつ、その小さな繋がり
が嬉しくもある。

dialogues.en: As the door locks, Yoriko-san sneakily moves closer to me.
dialogues.text: As the door locks, Yoriko-san sneakily moves closer to me.

dialogues.jp:
鍵の音と共に、すすっと間合いを詰めてくる頼
子さん。
dialogues.en: I'm a bit embarrassed, so I make a straight face and say,
dialogues.text: I'm a bit embarrassed, so I make a straight face and say,

dialogues.jp: 俺は照れくささに、明後日の方向を見つつ言う。

dialogues.en: And I reach out to take her hand in mine.
dialogues.text: And I reach out to take her hand in mine.

dialogues.jp:
頼子さんの手を釣り上げようと、やはり明後日
の方を見ながら、腕を伸ばす。

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.en: I look at where my hand is. My hand's touching her hips.
dialogues.text: I look at where my hand is. My hand's touching her hips.

dialogues.jp:
糸の先──自分の手を見る。それは、頼子さん
のお尻に触れていた。
dialogues.en:
I almost jump up to Mars when I see the sight of my pervert
action.
dialogues.text:
I almost jump up to Mars when I see the sight of my pervert
action.

dialogues.jp:
首まで真っ赤に染め上げて、頼子さんはしゃが
み込んでしまった。
dialogues.en:
Her face and even her neck turn bright red, and she crouches
down.
dialogues.text:
Her face and even her neck turn bright red, and she crouches
down.

dialogues.jp: 手をにぱにぱと開閉する。前途は多難だ。
dialogues.en:
I wring my hands. I'm going to have a rocky road ahead of me
tonight.
dialogues.text:
I wring my hands. I'm going to have a rocky road ahead of me
tonight.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「しかも、仲良く手繋いだりしてるし……それ
　はボクんだぞっ」
dialogues.en: "And they're holding hands...... That's my job!"
dialogues.text: "And they're holding hands...... That's my job!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「二人して、塀の陰で何やってたんだろうねえ？
　うたまる」
dialogues.en:
"......Utamaru, what do you think they're doing behind that
wall?"
dialogues.text:
"......Utamaru, what do you think they're doing behind that
wall?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「しょうがないか。好きになっちゃったんなら。
　人の気持ちは止められないもんね」
dialogues.en:
"There's nothing I can do if they're in love. You can't stop
a feeling like that..."
dialogues.text:
"There's nothing I can do if they're in love. You can't stop
a feeling like that..."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「あ〜あ。お兄ちゃんに恨まれちゃうかな……」
dialogues.en: "Oh, no... Oniichan will be mad at me......"
dialogues.text: "Oh, no... Oniichan will be mad at me......"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「あ、でも、決闘とかになったりして♪　そし
　たら、エモノは何にしようかな。やっぱり、
　ドス？」
dialogues.en:
"But there might be a fight! If so, what should I use to
fight? A knife?"
dialogues.text:
"But there might be a fight! If so, what should I use to
fight? A knife?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「……分かってる。ジョークだよ、うたまる。
　せいぜい、金属バットくらいにしとくから」
dialogues.en:
"......I know, I know. I'm only joking, Utamaru. I'll be
kind and use a metal bat."
dialogues.text:
"......I know, I know. I'm only joking, Utamaru. I'll be
kind and use a metal bat."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「でも……決闘も辞さないつもりなのは、ジョー
　クじゃない」
dialogues.en: "But...... I'm not joking about having a fight."
dialogues.text: "But...... I'm not joking about having a fight."

dialogues.jp:
「さて、と、どこに行こうかな……。ほんとに
　リクエストはない？」
dialogues.en:
"Where should we go......? Are you sure don't have any
requests for where you want to go?"
dialogues.text:
"Where should we go......? Are you sure don't have any
requests for where you want to go?"

dialogues.jp:
きょろきょろと挙動不審に辺りを見回していた
のを、びくっとこちらに顔を向ける。
dialogues.en:
She was looking around restlessly, but then she looks at me
in surprise as I call her name.
dialogues.text:
She was looking around restlessly, but then she looks at me
in surprise as I call her name.

dialogues.en:
"You're looking around like this is your first time seeing
outside."
dialogues.text:
"You're looking around like this is your first time seeing
outside."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.en: "......Is it because you have a higher viewpoint now?"
dialogues.text: "......Is it because you have a higher viewpoint now?"

dialogues.jp:
猫との視点と人間の視点じゃ、見える世界にだ
いぶ違いがあると思ったのだ。
dialogues.en:
I was thinking that everything looks different from a cat's
lower viewpoint compared to a human's.
dialogues.text:
I was thinking that everything looks different from a cat's
lower viewpoint compared to a human's.

dialogues.jp:
猫している時から、あまり外には出なかったの
かもしれないな。
dialogues.en: Maybe she didn't even go out so much when she was a cat.
dialogues.text: Maybe she didn't even go out so much when she was a cat.

dialogues.jp: それはモグラ叩きのようなものだった。たぶん。

俺の意識は、それを思い出すまいとハンマーを
ふるっていたのだ。
dialogues.en:
My conscious mind is hammering my brain not to think about
it.
dialogues.text:
My conscious mind is hammering my brain not to think about
it.

dialogues.jp:
打撃を逃れ、ぷくぷくと浮かび上がってきたも
の──“つう”の最期。
dialogues.en:
Avoiding all of my hammer attacks, one memory slowly floats
up to my mind -- which means I lost the whack-a-mole game.
dialogues.text:
Avoiding all of my hammer attacks, one memory slowly floats
up to my mind -- which means I lost the whack-a-mole game.

dialogues.jp:
肩を叩かれる感触。何度か瞬きして、頼子さん
に目を向ける。
dialogues.en:
I feel a pat on my shoulder. I blink several times to get
back to reality and turn around to Yoriko.
dialogues.text:
I feel a pat on my shoulder. I blink several times to get
back to reality and turn around to Yoriko.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「……おりゃ、タバコのポイ捨てだけは許せな
　くてねえ」
dialogues.en:
"......I just can't stand watching someone throw away a
cigarette on the road."
dialogues.text:
"......I just can't stand watching someone throw away a
cigarette on the road."

dialogues.jp:
適当なサラリーマンをあごでしゃくる。……す
みません、見知らぬ人。
dialogues.en:
I nod over at a businessman. ......I'm sorry, innocent
businessman...
dialogues.text:
I nod over at a businessman. ......I'm sorry, innocent
businessman...

dialogues.jp:
「んま、んな事より、さっさとどっか行こう。
　今日は思いっきり楽しもう。な？」
dialogues.en: "Anyway, let's just go. Let's have some fun tonight, okay?"
dialogues.text: "Anyway, let's just go. Let's have some fun tonight, okay?"

dialogues.jp:
まだ浮かない顔をしている頼子さんを、俺は引っ
張っていった。
dialogues.en: I tug at Yoriko-san's hand, but she's still looking gloomy.
dialogues.text: I tug at Yoriko-san's hand, but she's still looking gloomy.

dialogues.en: ◆I was like a dehydrated person lying down on the ground, opening his mouth to the sky while waiting for rain to moisten his mouth.◆
dialogues.text: ◆I was like a dehydrated person lying down on the ground, opening his mouth to the sky while waiting for rain to moisten his mouth.◆

dialogues.en: And the time has finally come!
dialogues.text: And the time has finally come!

dialogues.jp:
楽しいはずなのだが、ついつい猫であった頃の
頼子さんの事を考えてしまう。
dialogues.en:
Enjoying the taste of imaginary rain in my mouth, I go
downstairs with light steps.
dialogues.text:
Enjoying the taste of imaginary rain in my mouth, I go
downstairs with light steps.

dialogues.jp:
そんな俺を見て、心配そうにする頼子さん、俺
は慌ててそんな考えを打ち消したのだった。
